environment.description: AWS deployment with API Gateway (REST API type) using a request validator resource (validateRequestBody: true) attached to the POST /orders method. The method integration request has a Model schema (application/json content type) defined with a JSON Schema draft-04 specification requiring: 'action' must be an enum of exactly ['CREATE'], 'orderId' must match pattern ^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{8}$ (max 10 chars), and all fields (customerEmail, amount, items) are required with strict types. The API Gateway model rejects any request where 'action' is not 'CREATE' with a 400 response before the message reaches the Lambda/SQS pipeline. A separate internal EventBridge rule handles state transitions (UPDATE/DELETE/PROCESS) triggered only by verified internal service events with IAM-authenticated PutEvents calls from the order-processing service role (arn:aws:iam::*:role/order-svc-internal) which enforces sequential processing via a Step Functions state machine with a Map state maxConcurrency of 1.
